# Daiwik Khedekar: full profile

Daiwik Khedekar is a 16-year-old founder from the UK and the CEO of Pythe, an AI cofounder with a team of AI agents that research, write, build and ship a startup's work. He started his first company, the clothing brand Krzna LDN, at 13, worked as a graphic designer for companies at 14, and has also built Black Box, Trackviso and Creddr.

## FAQ

### Who is Daiwik Khedekar?
Daiwik Khedekar is a 16-year-old founder from the UK and the CEO of Pythe, an AI cofounder with a team of AI agents that research, write, build and ship a startup's work. He started his first company, the clothing brand Krzna LDN, at 13, worked as a graphic designer for companies at 14, and has also built Black Box, Trackviso and Creddr.

### What is Pythe?
Pythe is an AI cofounder with a team of AI agents. You describe what you're building, Pythe writes up the company, researches the market and builds a ranked, stage-aware roadmap. Pytheus, the AI cofounder, hands tasks to six agents (researcher, writer, engineer, analyst, outreach and operator), each on its own cloud computer, and nothing goes live without the founder's approval. Daiwik Khedekar co-founded Pythe with Abhiram Kakarla and is its CEO.

### How old is Daiwik Khedekar?
Daiwik Khedekar is 16.

### What has Daiwik Khedekar built?
Pythe (an AI cofounder), Black Box (tamper-evident audit logs for AI agents), Trackviso (a gamified study tracker), Creddr (finance careers from zero) and Krzna LDN, a clothing brand he started at 13 that made five-figure revenue.

### What is Daiwik Khedekar good at?
Design (he was a graphic designer for companies at 14 and makes motion graphics and websites), growth and outreach, and building with AI tools, with more than 1,000 hours of building experience.

### Where does Daiwik Khedekar want to study?
He is aiming for Economics & Management at the University of Oxford.

### How do I contact Daiwik Khedekar?
Email daiwik@pythe.app, or message him on LinkedIn (daiwik-khedekar), X (@daiwikbuilds) or Instagram (@dwk.z).

# black box
the flight recorder for ai agents · [tryblackbox.dev](https://tryblackbox.dev)

![Black Box](/img/blackbox.jpg)

when an ai agent goes wrong, can you prove what it actually did?

usually no

the logs are scattered everywhere

the agent's own trace is literally the thing under review

and anyone with access can quietly edit the record

## so black box
- sits at a gateway outside the agent
- records every model call and tool call
- seals every entry in a sha-256 hash chain
- change one entry and the whole chain breaks
- anyone can verify the log offline

built for teams shipping agents, and the insurers covering them

-dk

# pythe
ceo · co-founded with abhi · [pythe.app](https://www.pythe.app)

![Pythe dashboard](/img/pythe-hero.webp)

**your ai cofounder with a team of ai agents to build anything**

me and abhi came into startups through vibecoding like loads of people

building was never the hard part. knowing what to do next was

so we built the thing we needed

## how it works
1. tell pythe what youre building. a link, a repo, a few notes, whatever
2. it writes up your company and researches the market
3. you get a ranked, stage-aware roadmap
4. pytheus (the ai cofounder) hands the tasks to six agents: researcher, writer, engineer, analyst, outreach and operator. each one gets its own cloud computer
5. nothing leaves pythe without your yes

## plugs into
github, slack, gmail, hubspot, notion, stripe, posthog. and claude, claude code, cursor, codex and chatgpt

## pricing
free, base at £29/mo, premium at £79/mo. 3 day free trial

we also wrote a 60 page founder's growth playbook and gave it away for free. no email, no gate

-dk
